From the Kroll reaction one mole of titanium (47.55 g) is produced along with two moles of MgCl2 (95.2 g), consuming 2 moles of Mg (48.6 g). The electrolytic recovery of Mg from MgCl2 ... is estimated at 20,500 Btu/ lb magnesium (13,200 kWh / MT of Mg). To produce 1MT of CP-Ti bar it is necessary to process approximately 33,100 pounds (15,000 kg) of TiCl4 to yield 8,400 pounds (3,800kg) of raw metallic titanium sponge of which 6,380 pounds (2,900 kg) has acceptable purity
